verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents a customizable Trust Center you can set up and publish. Nothing in the evidence shows it updating itself from the platform: there is no automatic sync of subprocessor lists, no document-renewal tracking and no live control-status feed. Publishing a trust center by hand is adjacent to this story, not the self-updating capability it asks for.

support.subject: As an operations lead, the trust center stays current on its own — subprocessor lists, document renewals, and control status update from the platform, not by hand
